selection_basis: The first four actionable records emitted by the canonical review queue after claim cleanup batch two completed and before any batch-three rewrite was applied.

observed_initial_queue.blocked_reason: The higher-priority preview consisted of sensitive or restricted records requiring actual-source and safety review rather than automatic practical rewriting.

guardrail: This batch records editorial rewrites, not scientific review. No entry is promoted to reviewed and no source is added merely to preserve inherited wording.

entries.decision: Remove fabricated trials, effect ranges, physiological explanations and internal outcomes. Preserve a bounded disagreement protocol that clarifies one claim, states uncertainty, names what could change either view and chooses a check or respectful stopping point.

Remove numeric confidence prescriptions, sample-size rules, fabricated observations and arbitrary update ranges. Preserve a belief-review record that separates claim, current basis, new information, disposition and future change condition.

Remove fabricated capacity, cleaning, communication and team outcomes, internal hit rates and unsupported biological explanations. Preserve a function-to-principle exercise that generates several applications and tests one safe reversible option.

Remove fabricated session outcomes, keeper multipliers, percentage claims and pseudo-precise timing rules. Preserve a provocation exercise that explores an extreme seed, restores real constraints and selects one feasible next test.
